prompt: I want to understand what hook events are available across Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Research the official documentation and compare capabilities. I need this to decide which events baton should rely on for its core governance.

assertions.name: events-listed-per-ide
assertions.description: Lists specific hook events available for each IDE (not just 'several events' but actual event names)

assertions.name: structured-comparison
assertions.description: Presents a structured comparison (table, matrix, or side-by-side) rather than prose-only

assertions.name: source-provenance
assertions.description: Identifies where the information came from (specific docs, code files, official references) per claim

assertions.name: governance-recommendation
assertions.description: Makes a specific recommendation about which events baton should rely on for core governance, with reasoning

assertions.name: gaps-acknowledged
assertions.description: Acknowledges gaps or uncertainties (e.g., Codex limited events, unverifiable external docs) rather than presenting all claims with equal confidence
